description: All test code must use ASCII-only characters. No Unicode symbols, emojis, or special characters. Use plain ASCII alternatives. Example: print('[PASS] Success') not print('[checkmark] Success')

do.description: Use ASCII-only characters. Example: print('[PASS] Agent initialized'); print('[ERROR] Config not found')

dont.description: Don't use Unicode or emojis. Example: print('[checkmark] Done') (wrong); print('[green_check] OK') (wrong)

guidance.description: Don't use Unicode arrows or symbols
